integrity: Mathematical proof and standalone exact integer-polynomial and rational checks are included. Scientific priority may require further specialist review; no independent validation has occurred.
mathematical_scope: Three-person well-mixed two-strategy Moran birth-death process with fitness from one past update, no self-replacement, positive payoffs, common one-mutant initial history.
scientific_limitations: No claims for larger populations, longer delays, different birth-death conventions, global monotonicity in delay, or non-linear fitness maps; the priority assessment is not exhaustive.
title: Sharp first-delay fixation phase diagram and selection-strength reversal in a three-individual Moran game
